title: FEM-Care-UTI: A Multiperspective Evaluation of Healthcare for Women with Recurrent Urinary Tract Infections in Germany from the Perspectives of Patients and Primary Care Physicians
summary:
Die Fragestellung der Studie bezieht sich auf subjektiv erlebte Versorgungserfahrungen von
Patientinnen sowie auf Einschätzungen und Vorgehensweisen von HausärztInnen im
ambulanten Versorgungskontext. 100 Patientinnen mit rezidivierenden Harnwegsinfektionen definiert als „2 Harnwegsinfektionen in 6 Monaten oder 3 in 12 Monaten“ sowie die behandelnden HausärztInnen in der ambulanten Regelversorgung sollen befragt werden.

interventions.name:
Women with recurrent urinary tract infections (rUTIs), defined as having experienced two urinary tract infections within 6 months or three within 12 months, as assessed in the questionnaire.
General practitioners (GPs) providing routine outpatient primary care.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients
Female sex.
Age ≥18 years.
Self-reported recurrent urinary tract infections, defined as at least two episodes within the previous 6 months or at least three episodes within the previous 12 months.
Sufficient proficiency in the German language to complete the study questionnaire independently.
General practitioners
Currently practicing as a general practitioner in the outpatient primary care setting.
Sufficient proficiency in the German language to complete the study questionnaire independently.
Exclusion criteria:
Patients
Age <18 years.
No self-reported recurrent urinary tract infections, as defined above.
Insufficient proficiency in the German language to complete the questionnaire independently.
General practitioners
Not practicing as a general practitioner in the outpatient primary care setting.
Insufficient proficiency in the German language to independently understand the study information and complete the questionnaire.
